plans.name: Drop-in
plans.summary: Not a GTC member? £15 gets you any class on the timetable. Sunday Community Sesh is the usual first one.

plans.name: 4-Class Pack
plans.summary: Four coached HTCC classes, any mix of Rebel, Lift, Engine, Run Club or Sunday Sesh. Needs GTC base membership (£44.10/mo). 8, 12 and 16 packs also available.

plans.name: Doubles Coaching
plans.summary: Programme built around you and your partner — split strategy, handovers, pacing. Priced per athlete.

plans.name: Online Coaching
plans.summary: 12–16 week periodised plan on TrainingPeaks, Garmin/Apple Watch synced, load tracked. Check-ins week 1 and 3, six-week review call, race strategy and fuelling.
